about.photo_alt: Painter at work on a ladder
about.title: Locally owned in Hood River
paragraphs: Ridgeline Painting is a small, local crew painting homes and businesses across the Columbia Gorge.
We take the time to prep every surface properly, protect your home while we work, and leave the job site clean at the end of every day.
From a single room to a full exterior, you get clear communication, a written estimate and a finish you'll be proud of.

estimate.title: Let's talk about your project.
estimate.text: Tell us what you'd like painted and we'll get back to you with a free, written estimate.
estimate.thanks: We got your request and will reach out soon to set up your free estimate.

services.name: Exterior Painting
services.blurb: Siding, trim and doors, with careful prep for a finish that lasts.
services.intro: A fresh exterior protects your home and boosts curb appeal. Most of a lasting paint job is in the prep, so that's where we start.
includes: Front doors, garage doors and shutters
Surface prep: washing, scraping, sanding, caulking and priming

services.name: Interior Painting
services.blurb: Walls, ceilings and trim, from a single room to the whole house.
services.intro: Whether it's one room or the whole house, we protect your floors and furniture, cut clean lines and leave every room ready to use.
includes: Floors and furniture covered and protected
A thorough cleanup when we're done

services.name: Cabinet Refinishing
services.blurb: A new look for dated cabinets, without the cost of replacing them.
services.intro: Refinishing gives your kitchen a whole new look for a fraction of the cost of new cabinets.
includes: Cleaning, sanding and priming for a durable finish

services.name: Deck & Fence Staining
services.blurb: Protect and refresh decks, fences and outdoor wood.
services.intro: Sun and rain wear down outdoor wood fast. Cleaning and staining brings it back and protects it for seasons to come.

services.name: Drywall Repair
services.blurb: Holes, cracks and damaged sections patched smooth and ready for paint.
services.intro: From small holes to damaged sections, we repair drywall so it blends in with the rest of the wall, then finish it with paint.
includes: Texture matched to the surrounding wall
Primed and painted to blend in

services.name: Pressure Washing
services.blurb: Siding, decks, driveways and patios cleaned, before paint or just to refresh.
services.intro: Pressure washing brings back siding, decks and concrete, and it's the first step of every exterior paint job.
